license_required.quote: No person shall purport to be a "licensed dietitian" or use the letters "L.D." in connection with the person's name, or use any words or symbols indicating or tending to indicate that the person is a licensed dietitian without meeting the applicable requirements and holding a license as set forth in this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: the director shall have the following powers and duties: (1) Examine and approve the qualifications of all applicants under this chapter and issue a license

degree_required.quote: The applicant received a baccalaureate degree or post-baccalaureate degree from a regionally accredited college or university with a major course of study in dietetics, human nutrition, food and nutrition, or food systems management

interval_years.quote: Every license issued under this chapter shall be renewed triennially on or before June 30

available.quote: The director shall grant, upon application and payment of proper fees, licensure to a person who, at the time of application, holds a valid certification or license as a dietitian issued by another state, territory, or jurisdiction if the requirements for that certification or license are equal to, or greater than, the requirements of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime determined to render the person unfit to practice dietetics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by a court of competent jurisdiction of a crime that the director has determined to be of a nature that renders the person convicted unfit to practice dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report in writing any disciplinary decision related to dietetic practice in another jurisdiction within required timeframes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report in writing to the director any disciplinary decision related to dietetic practice issued against the licensed dietitian or the applicant in any jurisdiction within thirty days of the disciplinary decision or within twenty days of licensure

definition_quote.value: The integration and application of scientific principles of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food, behavioral, and social sciences, in managing disease, and achieving and maintaining human health throughout the life cycle.
